key_insight: VibeVideoBench evaluates AI agents that create videos by writing code to render frames and synthesize sound. It shifts the focus from visual appeal alone toward precise, rule-consistent, and synchronized video content.
problem_solved: Diffusion video models struggle to reliably display exact formulas, correct charts, consistent game rules, and narration synchronized with on-screen events. This benchmark targets evaluation of an alternative: code-driven video generation.
method: Introduce 239 self-contained video-generation tasks in English and Chinese.
Cover 12 task categories to assess a range of code-driven video-generation capabilities.
Evaluate multimodal agents tasked with writing code that renders video frames and synthesizes audio.
impact: The benchmark gives practitioners a structured way to assess agents for precision-sensitive video creation. The supplied abstract excerpt does not report performance results, so it does not establish that these agents outperform diffusion models.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: task prompt → multimodal agent → rendering and audio code → generated video.
Benchmark overview with badges for 239 tasks, 12 categories, and English/Chinese coverage.
Precision icons representing formulas, charts, game rules, and synchronized narration.
Audio–video timeline illustrating alignment between narration and on-screen events.
paper_title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
paper_authors: Muxi Diao, Wenbin Xu, Lele Yang, Xuyang Ma, Yuzhe Chen
